ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows two separate benzene rings. The left component is an unsubstituted benzene ring. The right component is another benzene ring bearing an oxygen substituent connected to a terminal methyl group, i.e. an aryl-O-CH3 fragment. Curved arrows and a dot are also drawn, but they are not structural bonds. Reasoning following the assigned method: Count the six C-C bonds around the left benzene ring. Count the six C-C bonds around the right benzene ring. Then count the single bond from the right benzene ring carbon to O, and the single bond from O to the terminal methyl carbon. Exclude all bonds to hydrogen and ignore the curved arrows and dot. The total is 6 + 6 + 1 + 1 = 14.
